name: Barbell Push Press
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and rest a barbell across your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Brace your core, keep your torso vertical, and dip quickly a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive explosively upward through your legs and hips, transferring that momentum straight into pressing the bar overhead to full lockout.
Stabilize the bar overhead with straight legs, then lower it smoothly back to your front shoulders.
tips: Keep your torso upright and heels flat during the dip rather than hinging forward.
Wait until your legs have driven upward before finishing the push with your arms.
